name: Sweden (Spelinspektionen) Market Profile

minGameCycleMs.notes: No millisecond floor in the Act. A regulation-level requirement was not confirmed.

autoplay.notes: The statute requires the player to actively state and confirm the stake at each play, which is effectively an autoplay prohibition. The statutory wording is HIGH; characterising it as an outright ban is MEDIUM. Industry reporting cites a specific Spelinspektionen autoplay and reverse-withdrawal prohibition, but the instrument and commencement date could not be located.

otherProhibitions.notes: Directly constrains reel-stop presentation and symbol placement near paylines.

otherProhibitions.item: Free-play with a different outcome distribution from staked play
otherProhibitions.notes: The common practice of raising win rates in demo mode to aid conversion is expressly non-compliant here.

otherProhibitions.item: Bonuses beyond the player's FIRST occasion of play

mandatoryDepositLimit.value: The player MUST set an upper deposit limit for all online gambling
mandatoryDepositLimit.notes: Mandatory, not merely offered. A loss limit applies instead for vaerdeautomater. Operators must contact customers setting monthly deposit limits above SEK 10,000 (MEDIUM).

instantSelfExclusion.value: A 24-hour instant self-exclusion button for online casino, online bingo and computer-simulated slots
instantSelfExclusion.notes: This is IN ADDITION to Spelpaus. Operator self-exclusion set to indefinite is not reversible for 12 months.

dutyOfCare.value: Continuous behaviour monitoring with a documented action plan
dutyOfCare.notes: May involve health-related inferences; see steering/data-protection-privacy.md section 2.2.

selfExclusion.notes: From 2026-08-01 licensees must query it using an authority-issued Actor ID / API key over a defined interface, INCLUDING BEFORE DIRECT MARKETING (MEDIUM). The marketing-time check is easy to miss if self-exclusion is only wired into login and bet placement.

retentionPeriod.notes: Covers all data on gaming-system operation. One of the few retention periods confirmed at statute level in any market.

requirement.value: The gaming system MUST be located in Sweden, unless the operator is supervised by a foreign authority with a supervision agreement with Spelinspektionen, or grants satisfactory remote-access control
requirement.notes: The only hard, confirmed data-residency requirement among the European markets verified. This is a DEPLOYMENT ARCHITECTURE decision and must be settled in the first phase of market-entry assessment. Note this is a gambling-law requirement, separate from GDPR transfer rules.

certification.labModel: No named laboratory list. Conformity assessment by a body accredited under Regulation (EC) 765/2008
certification.notes: Re-assessment on demand at the licensee's cost. Gaming software must come from a holder of a Swedish software supplier permit (ch.11 section 6a).

consultantNotes: Sweden's distinguishing features are the mandatory (not optional) deposit limit, the near-miss design ban, the free-play parity rule, and the hard in-country gaming system requirement.
The near-miss ban is a GAME DESIGN constraint, not a platform one. It affects reel-stop presentation and must be reviewed by whoever owns the maths model and the animation spec together.
